purpose: Teach: 申し込み/専攻/子会社/持ち主/一環/一括/圧縮/復旧

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の、本気で、絶対、申し込み、絶対、手続き、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — get that research fund application moving. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Weight on the name. Clear-eyed expectation. A mentor laying down what matters, not performing authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。私の、本気で、絶対、専攻、絶対、分野、絶対、論文、絶対、まとめております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm compiling my thesis research now. Thank you for the confidence.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine, not stiff. Steady pace. Meets the seriousness without echoing it back mechanically. Slight warmth underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究関連の、本気で、絶対、子会社、絶対、情報、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check the subsidiary research networks too. Get me their current information.
lines.style: Clipped, specific. No padding. The tone of someone who knows what needs doing and expects it to be done. Still measured — not impatient, just direct.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、持ち主、絶対、教授、絶対、と、絶対、議論しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm discussing the thesis approach with my advisor right now.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Small breath before the commitment. Not defensive — just steady. The tone of someone trying to show they're taking this seriously without overselling it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地域貢献の、本気で、絶対、一環、絶対、講演会、絶対、引き受けろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Take the community lecture commitment. That matters too.
lines.style: Shift to something broader. Still firm, but with a note of belief in it — not just another task. Slight emphasis on the principle underneath the instruction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文を、本気で、絶対、一括、絶対、提出、絶対、する予定です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm planning to submit all the papers together once they're ready.
lines.style: Careful, methodical. Shows he's thinking ahead. Not rushing. The tone of someone who understands what's at stake and is pacing himself accordingly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究データの、本気で、絶対、圧縮、絶対、保管、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Back up the research data properly. Make sure it's secure.
lines.style: Shift to practical ground. Steady. The tone of someone who has seen things go wrong and won't let it happen here. Not alarmist — just non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。サーバーの、本気で、絶対、復旧、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm working on the server recovery now. It's being handled.
lines.style: Slight uptick in assurance. Not overconfident, but showing ground gained. The closing note of someone who came in uncertain and is leaving with a plan.
